scope: Independent read-only fixed 95+/15- two-harness delta: passive clientError observation, bounded/candid correlation, diagnostic-only result segregation and finally cleanup. Four fixed Git file contents plus their exact diff; no 74-pin closure reread, project mutation, Node/import/tests/PG/Chrome/HTTP/private env access.

conclusions.topic: Fastify and socket ownership remains with original handlers
conclusions.evidence: Observer is installed on the actual created center server before listen, requires an existing clientError handler, appends listeners rather than replacing/removing original handlers, and removes only its own two callbacks on finish. It records primitive metadata only: no socket.write/end/destroy, rawPacket/body/header reads, prevent/default swallowing, or altered forwarding behavior. Finish checks original handler identities remain. New callback receives only a private synchronous phase/step projection from runApps; no plugin callback is invoked.

WeakMap connection identity does not retain arbitrary sockets; error rows capped16, upstream rows128, over-cap increments dropped. Phase/step bounded allowlisted syntax; code max64; numeric port/bytesParsed validated; no error.message/rawPacket/cookie/token captured. Compact serialized result capped32KiB, excessive output returns complete:false with empty arrays and byteCapExceeded. dropped/invalidPhase/original-handler mismatch all make complete false; fixture close records that as cleanup error. Existing saveJson separately caps the pretty raw file2MiB.

conclusions.topic: Association is conservative candidate metadata, not causality proof
conclusions.evidence: Each public proxy request fixes wireIndex immediately at records.push. Its actual upstream socket captures local/remote ports; center connection WeakMap records inverse endpoint ports plus connectionId. Only exactly one matching upstream row is labelled OWNED_PROXY with wireIndex; zero, missing ports or multiple candidates remain UNKNOWN. Error metadata does not infer a URL/token/message from the parser error itself. Interpretation must keep the endpoint-correlation limit below.

conclusions.topic: Diagnostic cannot import formal reports or pass compatibility
conclusions.evidence: Dedicated export validates the same exact recovery admission, sets diagnosticOnly true and selects exactly one admitted recovery artifact. Formal cookiePolicy and later compatibility/legacy/assets observations are intentionally not claimed. Early diagnostic return occurs only after real UNKNOWN reload, original request retry, delayed logout chain and succeeded verified task; it retains page errors as failure and console errors as observations. runApps still executes finally. reports starts null and its only assignment is guarded !diagnosticOnly. passed is explicitly !diagnosticOnly && ... and therefore always false for this entry; diagnosticComplete is separate and requires no errors, exactly one completed selected result and complete passive evidence.

conclusions.topic: Finally cleanup remains authoritative before diagnostic completion
conclusions.evidence: Early diagnostic return still executes checkApp finally: remove selected observation, close owned context, save wire/page facts. runApps then closes Chrome, calls fixture.close, separately settles pending proxy operations and saves all wire; any error is accumulated. Fixture close retains proxy destroy/close/pending settlement then center close; observer finish/save is independently caught so it cannot bypass normal marker/zero-connection/DROP path. Creation failure still calls close before rethrow. Invalid observer evidence or cleanup errors prevent diagnosticComplete, and no formal import follows. Exact process/EOF/port/DB proof still belongs to the admitted outer lifecycle and actual receipts, not this static source review.

conclusions.topic: Formal compatibility entry preserves previous strictness
conclusions.evidence: Existing exports leave diagnosticOnly false. They retain cookiePolicy, all3/4 App selections, original checkApp tail assertions, cleanup-first report import and result.passed assertion. New observation is enabled only for the diagnostic export, so it does not change normal server listener setup or create a new formal console-error allowance.

precisionLimits: OWNED_PROXY is a unique observed endpoint-tuple candidate, not cryptographic/socket-generation or parser-packet causality proof. There is no interval/connection-generation join between center and client sockets; tuple reuse after closure is not independently excluded. Do not convert this diagnostic label into proof that a particular HTTP body or browser mutation caused the parser error; zero/multiple candidates stay UNKNOWN.

diagnosticEvidence.complete means bounded capture was not dropped/invalid; it does not require errors.length>0. A zero-error run may complete the diagnostic without reproducing the reported clientError.

The32KiB observer cap measures compact JSON before saveJson pretty formatting. Do not claim a strict32KiB physical output file cap; actual retained bytes are independently bounded/accounted by the outer caller and saveJson2MiB file limit.

diagnosticOnly completed page/raw facts are not formal compatibility evidence: cookiePolicy/legacy fallback/final rendered reply and full asset manifest checks are skipped by design. The formal path still performs them.

No runtime assertions, installed Node/Fastify behavior probe, parser reproduction, resolution check, native browser result, resource grant or deployment attestation was performed. Parent/worker private caller delta is under separate root review.
